title: Seller Calc Hub - SEO Keyword-to-Page Architecture Map

competing_pages.overlap_nature: General eBay seller fee calculation vs legacy Managed Payments + PayPal calculation
competing_pages.resolution_strategy: /ebay-fee-calculator/ is the canonical destination for modern Managed Payments (13.25% + $0.40); /ebay-and-paypal-fee-calculator/ is dedicated to legacy fee structures, historical fee models, and PayPal merchant comparisons.

competing_pages.overlap_nature: All-in-one fee calculation vs category-specific tiered Final Value Fee rates
competing_pages.resolution_strategy: /ebay-final-value-fee-calculator/ is specifically focused on category-tier breakdown tables (e.g. guitars, watches, heavy equipment, sneakers) with detailed rate ladders; /ebay-fee-calculator/ serves general listing profitability.

competing_pages.overlap_nature: Forward fee deductions vs net margin and target ROI pricing
competing_pages.resolution_strategy: /ebay-profit-calculator/ specifically targets reverse-pricing mode (calculating required sale price from target profit or target margin %) and break-even pricing; /ebay-fee-calculator/ focuses on forward fee deductions.

competing_pages.overlap_nature: Total transaction fee on shipping vs standalone shipping handling deductions
competing_pages.resolution_strategy: /ebay-shipping-fee-calculator/ educates sellers on how eBay applies the full FVF percentage to buyer-paid shipping and calculates net shipping margins; /ebay-fee-calculator/ incorporates shipping into gross total.

competing_pages.overlap_nature: Regional/currency ambiguity when UK searchers type generic fee queries
competing_pages.resolution_strategy: /ebay-fee-calculator-uk/ explicitly targets the UK market (£ GBP, 0% private seller fee, 20% VAT on business fees, and Regulatory Operating fees); /ebay-fee-calculator/ targets US $ USD rates.

competing_pages.overlap_nature: Base Etsy seller fees vs 12% / 15% offsite advertising fee surcharges
competing_pages.resolution_strategy: /etsy-offsite-ads-fee-calculator/ targets shop owners navigating mandatory 12% ($10k+ trailing 12-month revenue) and optional 15% offsite ads; /etsy-fee-calculator/ models standard 6.5% transaction and listing fees.

competing_pages.overlap_nature: Multi-marketplace comparison queries vs individual marketplace calculations
competing_pages.resolution_strategy: /marketplace-fee-calculators/ acts as the hub page targeting cross-platform comparison searches across all platforms; /depop-fee-calculator/ serves single-platform Depop queries.
